outcome: Feasibility of estimating AQP5 and β-ENaC gene expression in exfoliated respiratory epithelial cells from gastric aspirate
Comparison of AQP5 and β-ENaC gene expression in gastric aspirate and nasal scrapings
finding: Quantitation of the expression of AQP5 and β-ENaC genes in gastric aspirate obtained shortly after birth from term newborns is feasible.
mod_finding: AQP5 gene expression was greater in babies delivered by cesarean section; β-ENaC gene expression was greater in babies delivered vaginally, but only in the nasal samples.
